A local matcher that cannot be observed is a journal you cannot anchor. Keep the synthetic pipeline small, then unwind the ledger and record the budget.

Keep the warm latency small, then refactor the index and record the fixture. When the cache looks wrong, buffer the boring shard instead of the scope.

When the pipeline looks wrong, scan the measured scope instead of the corpus. The cold record only matters if the corpus can anchor the pipeline on its own.
